2. Issue notice upon the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc., must be filed on or before 22.12.2023 failing which this application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.

Gaya in Tekari P.S. Case No. 247 of 2017, whereby cognizance of offences under Patna High Court CR.

has been taken, shall remain stayed.
